Here's a corrected and slightly refined version:

**"As suggested, going forward, let's make sure to include the SQL_ID in our requests to the L2/L4 team when asking for query tuning. This will help avoid unnecessary back-and-forth and prevent delays in the investigation."**

### Changes made:
- **"specifically mention"** → **"include"** – slightly more concise and professional.
- Split into two sentences for better readability.
- **"so there is no back and forth questioning delaying"** → **"This will help avoid unnecessary back-and-forth and prevent delays in"** – smoother phrasing and more professional tone.
